name: herdr-orchestra
description: Orchestrate AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Amp, Pi) as one team: a lead plans, coders build, a reviewer checks, you get one PR. Runs in Herdr panes, or in one Pi window with subagents.
